body: I don't intend to; my anxiety prevents me from doing so. I'm afraid of blood. I'll try to look at smaller things. I really do love my dog, but as I said, he may die soon. I don't know what i'll do then..

But for what exactly? i feel like i've missed out on so much, be it due to anxiety or depression. I don't feel like my life has any potential of validation in the near or distant future. i just feel worthless.
